name: ci-doctor
description: Skills that teach your coding agents to make CI fast, reliable and efficient, and keep it that way.

interface.longDescription: Skills that teach your coding agents to make CI fast, reliable and efficient, and keep it that way. Your agent measures CI from its history and writes a plan for you to approve before anything changes. Day to day, its skills diagnose failed runs, cut checks an edit doesn't need, fix slow or flaky tests without losing what they prove, size runners on any provider or Blacksmith and shorten their queues, check that a speed-up, saving or fix holds up before anyone quotes it, and keep agents' instructions and the repo's facts short and true.
defaultPrompt: Make this repo's CI faster and cost less: start the ci-doctor plan.
Why did this PR's CI check fail?
Our Actions bill doubled last month. Find out why.
